create_table: CREATE TABLE clientes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, razon_social TEXT, cedula TEXT, nombre_fantasia TEXT, idtipocliente INTEGER, credito REAL, plazo INTEGER, idsucursal INTEGER, idmoneda INTEGER, saldo DECIMAL(23,5))

pull.sql: SELECT id, nombre AS razon_social, cedula, web AS nombre_fantasia, idtipocliente, credito, plazo, idsucursal, idmoneda, saldo FROM clientes WHERE idsucursal = %s AND id > %s AND id <= @@last_id ORDER BY id
pull.lookup: JOIN sync_ids b ON b.id_servidor = ? AND b.tabla = 'clientes' JOIN sync_ids c ON c.id_servidor = a.idmoneda AND c.tabla = 'monedas' JOIN sync_ids d ON d.id_servidor = a.idtipocliente AND d.tabla = 'tipo_clientes'

queue.sql: SELECT id, nombre AS razon_social, cedula, web AS nombre_fantasia, idtipocliente, credito, plazo, idsucursal, idmoneda, saldo FROM clientes WHERE idsucursal = %s
